entities.title: Interpret exactly the keywords the UTV schema uses
entities.summary: Structural validation runs on a small JSON Schema interpreter of its own, which knows only the keywords schema/utv-1.0.schema.json uses and refuses to load if the schema uses any other.
entities.context: Every value, top-level and nested, must be checked against the repository's structural schema (JSON Schema 2020-12). The library has no runtime dependencies beyond the BCL.
entities.decision: SchemaInterpreter evaluates $ref, type, const, enum, minLength, pattern, items, minItems, required, properties, additionalProperties, oneOf, anyOf and not, and treats $schema, $id, $defs, title, description and format as annotations. Any other keyword makes loading fail. JSON Schema semantics are kept where .NET differs: $ in a pattern is rewritten to \z (ECMA-262 anchoring), minLength counts code points, integer accepts 2.0, and numbers compare exactly.
entities.rationale: The class comment: loading fails on any other keyword, so a schema change can never be silently ignored. Patterns run with RegexOptions.NonBacktracking, which guarantees matching time linear in the input length.

entities.title: Check #/$defs/value by dispatching on kind
entities.summary: Instead of evaluating the schema's oneOf over the 26 per-kind schemas, the interpreter picks the one per-kind schema the value's kind names.
entities.context: #/$defs/value is a oneOf over the 26 per-kind schemas, each pinning kind with const. Evaluating the oneOf reports only that no branch matched.
entities.decision: CheckUtvValue reports missing-property for a missing kind, unknown-kind for a kind outside the 26, and otherwise checks the value against #/$defs/<kind>Value.
entities.rationale: It is equivalent to the oneOf and gives the diagnostics of the one applicable branch. A test checks that the schema keeps that shape.

entities.title: Detect duplicate keys in the library itself
entities.summary: JSON is tokenized by JsonDocument but converted into the library's own node tree, which rejects a repeated key at any depth, after unescaping.
entities.context: UTV fails closed on duplicate JSON keys. System.Text.Json's JsonDocument accepts them and keeps the last value (shown by the native-first test JsonDocumentTests).
entities.decision: StrictJson.Parse reads with JsonDocument (no comments, no trailing commas, MaxDepth 128) and converts every element to JNode; a key already present in the object, compared after unescaping, throws duplicate-key with its JSON Pointer. Unpaired surrogates are malformed-json.
entities.rationale: Fail closed on duplicate keys (implementations/README.md obligation 7), at every depth, and report where.
